post_test_notes: First scoped fix exited 0 with a needless_collect warning and no source changes.
The collected worker handles deliberately ensure all reservation threads spawn before any join; a documented expect annotation retained actual concurrency.
Scoped formatting changed nine native source/test files; explicit vendor formatting changed only utf32_allocation_tests.rs.
Final scoped fix exited 0 with unchanged source and no warnings in its log.
Global integration formatting later reformatted native_budget_tests.rs again; all before/after hashes are preserved. No tests were rerun solely for format/lint.
implemented: Native fixed-index selection enforces per-session index entries and charged retained index bytes, including fixed storage, optional highlighting scratch and prepared owned path/column payloads.
Preflight counts dedicated OS workers as 2*T+2 and rejects unsupported/overflowing allocations before admission.
Atomic ledger reservations update entry and byte counters together, retain first exhaustion, and stop further admission. Exhausted partial walks cannot report successful complete/idle.
Borrowed UTF32 allocation plans preserve existing ASCII/Unicode/grapheme conversion and permit charging exact retained column bytes before owned allocation.
Native bounded create and owner bounded create retain typed startup/close receipts. Joined failure releases slots; uncertain cleanup quarantines slots.
A separate retained error cell preserves the first native operation error if reporter teardown later panics and loses the close task receipt; legacy anyhow wrapper semantics remain conservative.
limits: The actual NativeSearchBackend trait implementation and aggregate composition service do not exist in this snapshot.

Bounds cover retained native index allocation and dedicated OS-worker admission, not total RSS, all traversal temporaries, all query/output buffers, allocator overhead or arbitrary filesystem-call duration.
No independent native search worker package, install/remove/replace acceptance, new CLI/App Server binary or GUI runtime gate is established.
The WIP also contains unrelated high-level client shutdown work not compiled by this native test.
